entities.name: NAD(P)H-hydrate repair Nnr
observations: 531-aa query has 42.7–46.7% identity and approximately 96% coverage to reviewed Nnr proteins.
Homology supports bifunctional activity: epimerization of NAD(P)HX and ADP-dependent dehydration of (6S)-NAD(P)HX; direct assay of query not established.
Reference annotations list EC 5.1.99.6 and EC 4.2.1.136.

entities.name: (6S)-NADHX dehydration
observations: (6S)-NADHX + ADP = AMP + phosphate + NADH + H(+); Rhea RHEA:32223; EC 4.2.1.136.

entities.name: (6S)-NADPHX dehydration
observations: (6S)-NADPHX + ADP = AMP + phosphate + NADPH + H(+); Rhea RHEA:32235; EC 4.2.1.136.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX epimerization
observations: (6R)-NADHX = (6S)-NADHX (Rhea RHEA:32215); corresponding NADPHX epimerization (Rhea RHEA:32227); EC 5.1.99.6.
